name: Old-Time Radio
description: 1930s golden-age radio and newsreels: walnut bakelite, brass, cream dial faces, speaker-grille textures and art-deco type. A newsreel countdown open, an EXTRA! newspaper headline card and a cathedral-radio dial score. Every graphic type, plus basketball, football and hockey.
